notes: Sign board and chain links are separate mesh components

blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval wooden shop post and hanging sign. It consists of a vertical square timber post reinforced with metal bands/brackets, a horizontal timber arm extending outward with a curved wooden corner brace, and an irregularly shaped wooden board suspended below via two sets of metal chains and brackets. Both sides of the suspended sign board are painted with a reddish-purple and white turnip (or radish/beet) with green leafy tops. The model features clean, continuous, solid stylized geometry and hand-painted style textures, standing firmly on the flat base of the vertical wooden post without any extra ground slab.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a thick horizontal brown beam running left to right, capped with a grey metal bracket on the right end and joined to a square post top on the left with another metal bracket; cast shadows show the full profile and the hanging sign board below.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top of the post is roughly equal to or slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 ft tall), and the width across the post and crossbeam is approximately 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
